anesthesia_cf_usd.name: anesthesia_cf_usd
anesthesia_cf_usd.description: Anesthesia conversion factor in USD (scaled from integer cents). Raw CMS file values are integer cents (e.g., 1931 → $19.31). Parser scales by dividing by 100.0 and rounding to 2 decimal places.
anesthesia_cf_usd.notes: CMS publishes as integer cents for precision. Parser must scale to USD. Zero is not valid (CF must be positive). Typical range: $15-35 USD.

effective_from.name: effective_from
effective_from.description: Effective start date (Jan 1 of year, derived from filename or metadata)
effective_from.notes: Parser derives from filename (e.g., ANES2025 → 2025-01-01) or metadata vintage_date

effective_to.name: effective_to
effective_to.description: Effective end date (Dec 31 of year, or null for current/future years)
effective_to.notes: Set to Dec 31 only for past years; null for current/future

row_content_hash.name: row_content_hash
row_content_hash.description: 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of row content per STD-parser-contracts v2.0 §5.2. Computed from columns in declared order excluding metadata fields. Uses schema-defined precision for numeric normalization.

business_rules: Conversion factor typical range: $15-35 USD (WARN outside this range)
Expected 100-120 localities per release (matches GPCI universe)
Raw CMS values are integer cents; parser scales to USD
storage_note: Stored as float64 in Parquet for efficiency. Canonicalized to Decimal with schema-defined precision (2dp) before hashing to ensure determinism.

changes: BREAKING: Corrected natural key from ['locality_code', 'effective_from'] to ['mac', 'locality_code', 'effective_from']
Rationale: locality_code='00' appears in multiple states (AL, AZ, AR, etc.); MAC disambiguates
Prevents false duplicates (same issue found in GPCI v1.2 → v1.3)
Added mac column definition with validation pattern (5 digits)
Updated primary_keys to match natural key
Removed state_fips from schema (not present in ANES layout)
Changed precision from 4dp to 2dp (matches CMS cents precision: 1931 → $19.31)
Added units & scaling: raw integer cents → USD with precision (2dp), rounding (HALF_UP)
Set min_value to 0.01 (CF must be positive, not zero)
Added effective_from/to derivation notes (from filename or metadata)
Added CF validation ranges: WARN [15.0, 35.0], FAIL [0.01, 100.0]
Fixed version from internal 1.1 to explicit 1.1 (clean version history)
NOTE: v1.0 had incorrect NK (missing MAC) and included non-existent state_fips column
